scope: Repaired optimizer snapshot over the pinned captured 64-bit Linux v6.12 core. External boot/setup/decompressor and vDSO preparation remain reference stages. No raw-source Kbuild or bare-metal qualification.

compile.scope: captured preprocessed C plus handwritten assembly to objects; excludes preprocessing, host tools, objtool, archives, linking and packaging

link_timing.scope: direct final link only; own linker per compiler; excludes objtool, archives, packaging and preprocessing; hash validation outside timer
